name: email_review
description: Create a review record for a draft email to be reviewed by a human

escalation_reasons.description: Reasons why this case is being escalated for human review

revision_count.description: Number of Writer revisions applied before this draft

attachment_status.description: valid | incomplete | wrong_form | unreadable | missing | not_applicable

form_id.description: Form id matched against (or received instead of) the expected form

form_name.description: Human-readable name of the expected or received form

missing_fields.description: Field labels left blank on an incomplete form

received_filenames.description: Filenames of attachments received on this message
